Climate change in Texas.question: The Texas State Energy Conservation Office (_____) researches and assists public and private entities in securing grants to encourage the use of alternative fuels
Climate change in Texas.fact: The Texas State Energy Conservation Office (SECO) researches and assists public and private entities in securing grants to encourage the use of alternative fuels.
